thread:
Lina: FYI AcmeHealth procurement pinged asking for our SOC 2 Type II report + interim evidence. NDA already signed but they want a bridge letter + short-lived evidence links to finish legal review. Can Legal + Sec weigh in?

Jen (Legal): We can issue a bridge letter. Need: exact customer legal entity name, scope of evidence (prod only vs prod+staging), intended expiry for the access window, and confirmation Sec is ok with presigned link approach. Also whether they require a redacted PDF or limited cover page only.

Marco (Sec): We prefer presigned, time-limited S3 objects with bucket logging. Scope ok to be production infra only. We'll redact internal IPs and service account identifiers. Recommend 30-day bridge window + 72h presigned objects for each evidence bundle.

Ben S: I can produce the evidence zip: control-matrix.csv, iam-policies.tar.gz (redacted), bastion-proxy-config.txt (sanitized), and sample-logs.tar.gz (last 7 days, scrubbed). I'll upload to redwood-inference-evidence/acme_qas and add object lifecycle to expire.

Lina: AcmeHealth asked explicitly for: control matrix, IAM snapshots, syslog samples, and SOC2 engagement status. They want a written timeframe for final report delivery.

Jen (Legal): Draft bridge wording (short):

```
Redwood Inference confirms that a SOC 2 Type II examination for the period Jan 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025 is in progress. Interim access to supporting evidence has been provided to AcmeHealth under controlled, time-limited conditions for the purpose of procurement review. Delivery of the final SOC 2 Type II report is anticipated on or before 2025-05-28. This bridge letter is informational only and does not constitute an audit opinion.
```

Jen (Legal): Will add contact and link instructions. Keeping it explicit that were not sharing credentials.

Marco (Sec): Please use: presigned_url (72h expiry), IP allow-list optional, and require reviewer to acknowledge access terms. I'll also enable ACL changes and daily access log zips to the sec mailbox.

Ben S: Upload done (redacted). Presigned bundle: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-inference-evidence/acme_qas/2025-04-12-evidence.zip?region=us-west-2 (expires in 72 hours). Audit logs enabled. :lock:

sec-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded and bucket logging enabled. Access logs will be delivered to security-logs@redwood.internal every 24h. Event ID: evt-20250412-8921.

Lina: Jen - can you sign the bridge letter and I'll attach the presigned link + short access guide and send to Acme procurement?

Jen (Legal): Signed and saved to Drive. Access guide snippet: 

```
Access guide (to include with email):
1) Click the presigned link. Links expire after 72 hours.
2) Do not attempt to download or re-publish any raw credentials or keys.
3) Contact legal@redwood.com for questions.
4) We will provide a receipt of access events upon request.

Example fetch (read-only):
curl -O "<presigned-url>"
```

Marco (Sec): Also note: evidence is redacted for PII and service accounts. We did a quick scan to ensure no private keys were included.

Lina: Sent to AcmeHealth procurement with bridge letter and access guide. cc: Jen, Marco, Ben. They replied: "Thanks — reviewing now. This should move us to final sign-off barring questions"

Ben S: Rotated any temp tokens used for upload. Confirmed presigned links will auto-expire; I added object tags: "soc2-temp" and "acme-review".

sec-bot: Token rotation completed for upload session. Presigned objects tagged. :white_check_mark:

Lina: Great work team. If procurement asks for additional artifacts (tester reports or architecture diagrams), flag here and we'll scope the redaction.

Jen (Legal): Noted. Keep an eye on download events; we'll coordinate if they request deeper drill-down.

Marco (Sec): Will monitor logs and escalate if any anomalous access patterns appear.

Lina: Closing thread for now unless Acme comes back with follow-ups. Thanks all!
